rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with dynamic Azure DevOps integration that automatically switches authentication context based on the current working directory, built by Sarin Na Wangkanai using TypeScript with local .azure-devops.json configuration files for secure per-repository PAT token storage. The implementation offers comprehensive Azure DevOps operations including work item management with WIQL query support, repository access, build pipeline triggering and monitoring, pull request management, and automatic project context detection through intelligent directory mapping with parent directory traversal. Built with fallback configuration support, robust error handling, and seamless Claude Code integration, it serves developers working across multiple Azure DevOps organizations who need zero-configuration project switching, teams requiring conversational access to DevOps workflows without manual context management, and organizations wanting to maintain separate authentication credentials per project while enabling AI-assisted Azure DevOps operations.
